english_description: The in-game title is Ocean II — confirmed (via file-by-file comparison) to be a genuine sibling snapshot of hy2000 and hy2002 elsewhere in this collection, sharing roughly 9,600 and 10,253 files by path with each respectively: this is the third version snapshot deployed on the "Shanghai server" of the same ES2/Jin-Yong-themed "Ocean II" codebase, not an independently developed game. Its map and marriage system (d/marry/) match the rest of the family, spanning sects including Wudang, Mingjiao, Shaolin, Emei, Kunlun, and Peach Blossom Island. Porting fixed the same bug set already catalogued across the Ocean II lineage — a dead-code MASTER_OB/SIMUL_EFUN_OB macro pointing at a stale copy, a missing-file crash in the login banner's "last crash reason" display, a WASM-incompatible socket daemon disabled to a no-op, and a missing defensive check before spawning the exit-time top-ten-list clone — confirming these are shared-lineage defects rather than anything unique to this snapshot.
